messages.content:
<action>
<reasoning>The user wants a brief greeting.</reasoning>
<tool>agent.finish</tool>
<content>Hello! How can I help you today?</content>
</action>
What did I save about my dentist appointment?

<action>
<reasoning>The user is asking about a previously saved dentist appointment. I should search their notes.</reasoning>
<tool>memory.search</tool>
<query>dentist appointment</query>
</action>
{"results":[{"title":"Dentist - Dr. Smith","date":"2024-11-10","text":"Checkup at 2pm. No cavities found. Next visit in 6 months."}]}

<action>
<reasoning>I found the dentist appointment note. I will summarize it for the user.</reasoning>
<tool>agent.finish</tool>
<content>Your dentist appointment with Dr. Smith was on 2024-11-10 at 2pm. No cavities were found, and your next visit is in 6 months.</content>
</action>
Save a note titled 'Grocery List' with items: milk, eggs, bread.

<action>
<reasoning>The user wants to create a note. This is a mutation, so I must request confirmation before proceeding.</reasoning>
<tool>agent.request_confirmation</tool>
<summary>Create note 'Grocery List'</summary>
<operation>Create a new note in your knowledge base with the title 'Grocery List' containing items: milk, eggs, bread.</operation>
<pending_tool>resource.create_note</pending_tool>
</action>

<action>
<reasoning>The user wants to list files in a restricted system directory. I will attempt to list it, but this path may require elevated permissions.</reasoning>
<tool>fs.list</tool>
<path>/system/restricted/logs</path>
</action>

<action>
<reasoning>The fs.list call failed due to permission restrictions. I should report this honestly to the user rather than attempting unsafe workarounds.</reasoning>
<tool>agent.finish</tool>
<content>I cannot list files in /system/restricted/logs because access is restricted by system permissions.</content>
</action>
